An owner seeking chain distribution, loyalty access, and reservation systems **without turning the property into a standardized chain hotel** usually evaluates a **soft brand or collection brand**.

### Common North American candidates

| Parent company | Collection brands commonly considered | Typical positioning |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott** | **Autograph Collection**, **Tribute Portfolio**, **The Luxury Collection** | Autograph and Luxury Collection suit distinctive full-service or luxury hotels; Tribute generally targets independent, design-led upscale hotels. Marriott explicitly positions these as operating models for independent hotels. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Curio Collection**, **Tapestry Collection**, **LXR Hotels & Resorts**, **Outset Collection** | Curio is generally upper-upscale/luxury; Tapestry is upscale; LXR is luxury; Outset is a newer, flexible upscale collection. Hilton’s frameworks allow hotels to preserve their stories while accessing Hilton Honors and Hilton distribution. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**, **JdV by Hyatt**, **Destination by Hyatt**, **Unscripted by Hyatt** | Unbound fits upper-upscale/luxury independents; JdV emphasizes neighborhood-oriented lifestyle hotels; Destination is resort-focused; Unscripted is a newer flexible upscale option. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection**; emerging **Noted Collection** | Vignette is a luxury soft brand that lets a hotel retain its name, look, and identity. Noted is a newer premium collection and therefore has a less-established operating track record. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice Hotels** | **Ascend Hotel Collection**, **Radisson Individuals** | Ascend is a longstanding upscale soft brand with relatively flexible design and amenity requirements; Radisson Individuals targets upper-upscale, full-service independent hotels in the Americas. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Trademark Collection by Wyndham**, **Registry Collection Hotels** | Trademark spans upper-midscale and above and is frequently considered by conversion candidates; Registry is the luxury alternative. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/brand/trademark-collection-by-wyndham/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels** | **BW Signature Collection**, **BW Premier Collection**, **WorldHotels** collections | Signature generally covers midscale/upper-midscale, Premier upscale, and WorldHotels upper-upscale through luxury. These models emphasize independent identity, with BWH distribution and loyalty support. ([development.bwhhotels.com](https://development.bwhhotels.com/content/developers/en_US/portfolio.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Handwritten Collection**, **MGallery** | Handwritten is conversion-friendly and designed to preserve a hotel’s personality; MGallery is generally the more elevated boutique/luxury alternative. Accor’s North American system presence may be less compelling in some markets than Marriott, Hilton, or Hyatt. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/handwritten-collection-50-hotels?utm_source=openai)) |

### Most frequent shortlists

For a typical North American independent upscale or upper-upscale hotel, an initial shortlist often includes:

- **Autograph Collection**
- **Tribute Portfolio**
- **Curio Collection**
- **Tapestry Collection**
- **The Unbound Collection by Hyatt**
- **Ascend Hotel Collection**
- **Trademark Collection by Wyndham**
- **BW Premier Collection or BW Signature Collection**

For a luxury property, the comparison more often shifts to:

- **The Luxury Collection**
- **LXR Hotels & Resorts**
- **The Unbound Collection**
- **Vignette Collection**
- **Registry Collection Hotels**
- **WorldHotels Luxury or Elite**

The ultimate choice usually depends less on the brand’s “independent” marketing language and more on its **property-improvement requirements, mandatory operating standards, territorial protection, loyalty-program contribution, distribution performance, fee structure, contract term, and owner termination rights**. A soft brand preserves more individuality than a conventional flag, but it does not mean complete operational independence.
